name: Judy Rodda
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2014 accepted abstracts, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Judy Rodda as an author of “Geovisual data mining of dolphin space-time trajectories”.
GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Judith Rodda as an author of “Routes to Dunedin secondary schools and students' perceptions of safety”.
GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Judy Rodda as an author of “Visualisation of active transport data”; “An augmented-reality sand-based 3D terrain interface”.

Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Judy Rodda as an author of “GIS analysis of active transport data in Dunedin”; “A tangible interface for land development teaching”.
The GeoCart 2016 programme and proceedings use “Judy Rodda” and “Judith Rodda” for the same cartographic contributor.
